steps.title: Prepare stock solutions
steps.instruction: Make all required reagent stocks and buffers as described, observing the specified concentrations, storage temperatures, and handling precautions.

substeps.instruction: 10% NaN₃: dissolve sodium azide in water; store at room temperature.
5 M NaOH: dissolve NaOH pellets slowly in water (exothermic); store at room temperature.
0.5 M TCEP: dissolve TCEP in degassed water, adjust pH to 7.4 with 5 M NaOH, aliquot 1 ml and store at –20 °C.
Protein buffer: add 0.5 mM TCEP (from the 0.5 M stock) to PBS, filter through a 0.22 µm syringe filter and degas; prepare fresh each use (do not store).
FACS buffer: mix PBS with 1 % (v/v) fetal bovine serum (FBS) and 0.02 % (w/v) NaN₃ (diluted from the 10 % stock); store at 4 °C.
Stimulation medium: combine RPMI with 1 % (v/v) FBS and 10 mM HEPES; store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Assemble and purify PhyBt
steps.instruction: Generate phytochrome B tetramers (PhyBt) by mixing monomers with DyLight650‑streptavidin, incubating, and purifying via size‑exclusion chromatography, then determine concentration, filter, aliquot, and store.

substeps.instruction: Purify biotinylated PhyB‑AviTag monomers as previously described (Hörner et al., 2020).
Mix a 10‑fold molar excess of PhyB‑AviTag monomers (1–5 mg ml⁻¹) with DyLight650‑conjugated streptavidin in protein buffer to a total volume of 2.5 ml.
Incubate the mixture either 2 h at room temperature or overnight at 4 °C in the dark.
Perform all subsequent steps in a 4 °C cold room, minimizing light exposure.
Equilibrate a HiLoad Superdex 200 pg column (GE Healthcare) with two column volumes of freshly prepared protein buffer.
Load the mixture onto the column using a 2 ml sample loop; run at a flow rate of 1 ml min⁻¹ for two column volumes, collecting 1 ml fractions.
Monitor elution at A₂₈₀ (total protein), A₆₅₀ (DyLight650‑streptavidin), and A₃₆₅ (PhyB).
Pool all fractions containing PhyBt.

Determine PhyBt concentration by the ΔΔA method: record a difference spectrum, subtract the minimum at 711 nm from the maximum at 649 nm, multiply the ΔΔA value by 1.1 to obtain PhyB concentration in mg ml⁻¹, divide by the molecular weight of PhyB‑AviTag (74 000 g mol⁻¹) to get molarity of monomer, then divide by 4 to obtain PhyBt molarity.
Filter the PhyBt solution through a 0.22 µm syringe filter, aliquot, and store up to 4 weeks at 4 °C in the dark.
Typical yield: 80–90 % of the DyLight650‑streptavidin converted to PhyBt, giving a final PhyBt concentration of 0.5–3 µM.

steps.title: Incubate cells with PhyBt
steps.instruction: Expose Jurkat GFP‑PIF S‑TCR cells to PhyBt under defined light conditions and measure surface binding by flow cytometry.

substeps.instruction: Culture Jurkat GFP‑PIF S‑TCR cells under standard conditions and keep the culture density between 0.5 and 1.0 × 10⁶ cells ml⁻¹.
Aliquot 3 × 10⁵ cells per sample into 3.5 ml FACS tubes.
Centrifuge 4 min at 300 × g at 4 °C; discard supernatant and resuspend cells in 1 ml cold FACS buffer.
Repeat the centrifugation and supernatant removal once more.
During these washes, dilute PhyBt in FACS buffer to a final concentration of 100 nM; prepare 50 µl of diluted PhyBt per sample (total volume depends on number of samples).

Split the PhyBt solution into two equal parts: illuminate one half with saturating 660 nm light and the other half with saturating 740 nm light (5 min at 100 µmol m⁻² s⁻¹). Perform all handling under green safe light and avoid any white light.
Resuspend each cell sample in 50 µl of the appropriate PhyBt (660 or 740) solution and incubate 30 min on ice in the dark.
Wash the cells twice as described above (centrifuge 4 min at 300 × g, discard supernatant, resuspend in 1 ml cold FACS buffer).
Finally, resuspend cells in 200 µl cold FACS buffer and measure DyLight650 fluorescence on a flow cytometer.

steps.title: Stain cells and record Ca²⁺ influx
steps.instruction: Load Jurkat GFP‑PIF S‑TCR cells with Indo‑1, expose them to PhyBt under controlled illumination, and monitor calcium influx by flow cytometry.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 5 × 10⁶ freshly dividing Jurkat GFP‑PIF S‑TCR cells into a 15 ml conical tube.
Centrifuge 4 min at 300 × g at room temperature; discard supernatant and gently resuspend cells in 1 ml stimulation medium (avoid vortexing).
Repeat the centrifugation and supernatant removal once more.
Prepare Indo‑1 staining solution while the cells are centrifuging: mix 5 µl Pluronic F‑127, 4 µl Indo‑1, and 1 ml stimulation medium.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 1 ml of the staining solution, transfer to a 1.5 ml reaction tube, and incubate 15 min in a cell‑culture incubator with the lid open.
Close the lid, gently invert the tube 5–10 times, and incubate an additional 15 min.
Centrifuge again (4 min, 300 × g, room temperature), discard supernatant, and resuspend the cells in 500 µl cold (4 °C) stimulation medium.
Keep the cells on ice and in the dark for 15 min before measurement.
For each measurement, prepare a 1 ml cell suspension by mixing 50 µl stained cells with 950 µl pre‑warmed (37 °C) stimulation medium in a FACS tube.
Place the FACS tube into the pxONE incubation/illumination device and insert the device into the flow cytometer.
Record a 1‑min baseline Indo‑1 fluorescence signal.
Add 2–200 nM PhyBt(660) or PhyBt(740) to the cell suspension and record fluorescence for an additional 5 min in the dark.
Adjust PhyBt concentration and illumination regime as required for specific experimental questions.
